system.description:
Make an Interface Roll against a target
within Very Close range. If you use this
protocol on an ally, roll with advantage.
On a success, mark a Stress and
choose one of the following effects:
1- The target grows calmer, stabilized
by sedatives or neural regulation, and
clears a Stress. On a success with
Hope, they clear 2 Stress.
2- The target grows more anxious,
overloaded by adrenaline, panic
chemicals, or hostile feedback, and
marks a Stress. On a success with
Hope, they mark 2 Stress.
